en.title: [Scholarship] 2027 Haedong Scholarship Application Notice (By 10/27 Morning)
summary: Recruitment of 2027 Haedong Scholarship recipients (3 recommended students from the Department of Artificial Intelligence Engineering).
Eligibility: Students scheduled for regular registration in semesters 2-1, 2-2, or 3-1 as of the 2027-1 semester, with Korea Student Aid Foundation income percentile 0–4 (as of 2026-1 semester).
Scholarship benefit: 12 million KRW per year per person (paid monthly in 1 million KRW installments, living expense scholarship).
Submission deadline: By 12:00 PM on October 27, 2026 (Tue).
Submission method: Submit via email to the Department of Artificial Intelligence Engineering office (kkn25@inha.ac.kr).
en.easyExplanation: The Haedong Scholarship is recruiting students from the Department of Artificial Intelligence Engineering who are scheduled for regular registration in semesters 2-1, 2-2, or 3-1 in the 2027-1 semester. You must have a Korea Student Aid Foundation income percentile of 0–4 (as of 2026-1 semester) and be able to remain enrolled continuously for both 1st and 2nd semesters of 2027. Applications must be submitted to the department office email (kkn25@inha.ac.kr) by 12:00 PM on October 27, 2026 (Tue).
en.target: Department of Artificial Intelligence Engineering (인공지능공학과) students who are scheduled for regular registration in semesters 2-1, 2-2, or 3-1 as of the 2027-1 semester. Income percentile 0 to 4 (based on 2026-1 semester) from the Korea Student Aid Foundation (한국장학재단). Students planning to take a leave of absence (휴학) in the 1st or 2nd semester of 2027 are not eligible (must be able to continue studies for at least two consecutive semesters). Duplication with living expenses/study incentive scholarships is not allowed (National Scholarship and campus scholarships are allowed within the tuition amount).

author: 김경남
originalContent:
가. 추천 인원 : 인공지능공학과 3명
나. 추천 대상 :
1) 2027-1학기 기준으로 2-1학기, 2-2학기, 3-1학기 정규 등록 예정자
※ 2027학년도 1학기 및 2학기 휴학 예정자 불가(연속 두 학기 이상 학업 지속 가능자)
2) 소득 기준 : 한국장학재단 소득 구간 0 ~ 4구간 (2026학년도 1학기 기준)
3) 생활비·학업장려금성 장학금 중복수혜 불가
※ 국가장학금 및 교내장학금은 등록금액 이내 가능
다. 장학금액 : 1인당 연간 1,200만원 (생활비성 장학금)
※ 매월 100만원 분할 지급
신청서제출 : 인공지능공학과 학과사무실 : kkn25@inha.ac.kr
제 출 기 한 : 2026년 10월 27일(화) 12시까지
